newsitem.title: USA: Michael Baker unit wins $24.4 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Michael Baker unit wins $24.4 mln contract.

text.p: Michael Baker Corp said Monday a joint venture involving its Baker Support Services Inc unit has won a five-year operations and maintenance contract worth up to $24.4 million at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio.
The company said Baker Support is the managing partner of a joint venture with SERCo North America named Baker-SERCo.
The venture will provide management, operations and maintenance of the base's 1,500-vehicle fleet, it said.
The base contract is for one year plus four, one-year options, Baker said.
The company said the venture will employ about 90 people at the base.
